## What were you trying to do?

Describe the task or goal you were working on.

## What went wrong?

Explain what happened instead of what you expected.
Error messages are helpful, but not required.

## What did you expect to happen?

Describe the result you thought you would get.

## How often does this happen?

- Every time
- Sometimes
- Only once so far
- Not sure

## When did this start?

- Just now
- Recently
- I’ve seen this before but can’t remember when

## Steps you remember (if any)

If you remember roughly what you did before it happened, list it here.
It’s okay if this is incomplete.

1.
2.
3.

## Impact

How much does this affect your work?

- Minor inconvenience
- Slows me down
- Blocks my work completely

## Additional context (optional)

Include anything else that might help:
- Screenshots
- Logs
- Files
- Links
- Workarounds you tried
